senses.gloss: f., adv. בְּבַת [daughter, product of], בב׳ ראש (= בב׳ זקירת ראש) headlong; בב׳ אחת (= בב׳ עשייה אחת, בב׳ כתיבה &c.), at once, simultaneously, suddenly.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 38b:2">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>נזקרים בב׳ ר׳ לאחוריהם</he> (Ms. M. <he>בב׳ אחת</he>) staggered backward with a sudden movement (enchanted with the beauty of the music); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:7">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>נסקרין וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:18">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>נזקרין לו בת ראש</he> (read <he>בב׳</he>) rushed forward to him headlong (to congratulate him).
<cite ref="Yoma 67b:12">Yoma 67ᵇ</cite> <he>זוקרו בב׳ ר׳</he> Ar. a. Ms. Oxf. (ed. <he>זורקו</he>) he pushes the scapegoat down the precipice headlong.

<cite ref="Sukkah 14b:14">Succ. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שיזדקר בה גדי בב׳ ר׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>גדי ראשו בב׳ אחת …</he>, read <he>בב׳ ראשו</he>) wide enough for a goat to leap through with one headlong rush.

<cite ref="Eruvin 16a:3">Erub. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שלא יזד׳ הגדי בב׳ ר׳</he> (Ms. M. … <he>שלא ירקד הגדי בב׳ א׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 4:6">Tosef. Kil. IV, 6</cite> … <he>שלא יכנס הגדי</he>; Erub. l. c. bot. <he>בב׳ א׳</he>) less space than a goat would require &c.—
<cite ref="Yoma 38b:3">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>היה כותבה בב׳ א׳</he> would write a word of four letters (with four pens between his fingers) at a time.
<cite ref="Pesachim 86b">Pes. 86ᵇ</cite> who empties his goblet <he>בב׳ א׳</he> in one draught.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> they did not drop the curtain <he>בב׳ א׳</he> at once, opp. <he>קימעא קימעא</he>; a. fr.
